postal_system.assignment_rule: Correo Argentino maintains the current eight-character CPA. The first letter denotes province, four digits identify a city or locality, and the final three letters can identify an exact urban block face, a small settlement, a rural zone, a P.O. Box or another special delivery object. The old four-digit CP is not current and has not been updated since 1974. A text pattern or successful interactive lookup is not an open reusable assignment row, geometry, occupant, address-building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The reviewed Correo sources provide no canonical national CPA polygon dataset. A block-face assignment is a delivery object and does not by itself define an areal boundary. Georef address points and containing geographies, IGN or IDERA administrative/reference layers, provincial parcels, community buildings, interpolation, Voronoi, buffers, APIs and models remain independent or derived evidence; they cannot fill unknown CPA coverage or be relabelled official CPA geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building, street, house number, floor, unit, P.O. Box, neighborhood, locality, department or partido, province or CABA and current CPA as separate fields. Formatting guidance and synthetic fixtures contain no real example address, person, occupant, property or operator response.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as urban_block_face, small_settlement, rural_zone, po_box, organization, other_special or unknown. A full CPA may identify an area or non-area object; its letters and successful lookup do not determine a Polygon or MultiPolygon.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared civic address identity, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, purpose, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. CPA text, a Georef point, IGN or IDERA feature, provincial parcel, coordinate, containment, interpolation or proximity is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: National Cadastre Law 26.209 assigns cadastral administration to the provinces and CABA. Each jurisdictional artifact has separate legal authority, access, schema, validity, privacy and licence. Parcels, owners, possessors, occupants, values, tax records, units and permanent improvements are restricted or purpose-specific unless an exact lawful public artifact explicitly permits release.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Interactive lookup, permitted API observations, mathematical models and machine learning may normalize input, compress candidate surfaces, detect conflicts and prioritize review. Every output preserves source and model version, feature version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and derived status. It never overwrites Correo Argentino evidence, manufactures official geometry, infers a house number, unit, building or occupant, or converts absence into coverage.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate typed CPA objects, derived validation surfaces, administrative context, permitted civic-address points and explicitly linked buildings to AGID cells without relabelling postal, administrative, civic, parcel or building objects as AGID cells or claiming AGID geometry is official CPA geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Correo Argentino interactive CPA material is reference evidence and the operator states that it does not publish open code or locality lists. Pin exact lookup terms before storing permitted observations. Georef catalog records CC BY 4.0 but exact resources, release and digest must be pinned. IGN, IDERA and provincial or municipal artifacts retain layer-specific authority, access and licence; National Cadastre Law 26.209 is framework only. ODbL data stays separate.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO AR scope. It must not silently merge the separately coded FK, GS or AQ datasets, Antarctic claims, maritime claims, disputed sovereignty or postal routing scope into physical Argentine jurisdiction. Store asserted_by, recognized_by, legal_status, source boundary vintage and AGID jurisdiction independently.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact addresses, coordinates, entrances, floors, units, recipients, owners, possessors, occupants, cadastral or tax records, lookup responses, credentials and query logs can expose personal, property or security context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: CPA assignments and postal object types, old four-digit references, administrative names and boundaries, Georef or BAHRA resources, address points, building geometries, jurisdictional cadastre, API observations, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store object_type, valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source release and supersession independently; never rewrite historical evidence or promote cached/model output into a timeless fact.

stages.definition: Argentina address-format inventory and synthetic runtime fixture only.
Reviewed Correo Argentino CPA semantics, commercial-access evidence, Georef scope, rights, privacy, jurisdiction and no-proxy contract with exact official-body receipts.

A current complete Correo Argentino-authorized denominator of every ANNNNAAA assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed urban_block_face, small_settlement, rural_zone, po_box, organization, other_special or explicit non-area object is fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable row identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Individual epistolary lookup observations, text patterns, historical UPU examples, the commercial batch/Web Service description and Georef address or administrative responses do not satisfy the denominator. Every drawable CPA must be reconciled to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Block-face labels do not manufacture areal boundaries; Georef points or territorial entities, streets, address ranges, administrative/locality/census boundaries, parcels, buildings, Point buffers, interpolation, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and synthetic fixtures are prohibited proxies. Source-grounded route, P.O.-box, organization, Point or other non-area cases must expose their available geometry and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real AR API/app, which normalizes supported ANNNNAAA input, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, supports clear/re-search, and displays selected CPA, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: AR metadata, policy and synthetic fixture only; no current complete Correo assignment denominator or real AR Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A lawfully reusable immutable descriptor, approved real-data artifacts and actual AR loader/API/app area verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture an official CPA polygon. Independently licensed administrative, civic, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified; derived and virtual areas require a complete authorized assignment relationship and explicit provenance and never inherit postal authority.
